description: List named login identities (the multi-account layer) with metadata only: name, cookie domains, cookie count, updated_at, the last account_verify verdict, and the identity's persona User-Agent (each account is one stable device: its own UA and hardware fingerprint, drawn once and reused). Cookie values are credentials and never leave the server. Use to see which identities exist before session_create {account} picks one.
name: account_list
